answers.core:
this is a very useful (and expected) quality-of-life feature,
and it would be much more useful if
- it was enabled in Godot out-of-the-box
- it didn't block a [Control](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_control.html)'s script slot
- the [Control](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_control.html)s _only_ updated their size when changing the _window size_ project settings — not on every frame, which is the only way to do this in GDScript ∗

∗ maybe i could change the script to only update the size when changing the _window size_ project settings, if Godot adds the [signal](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_signal.html)
[``ProjectSettings``](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_projectsettings.html)``.setting_changed( name:``[``String``](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_string.html)`` )``
answers.workaround:
i can add a tool script to the [Control](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_control.html) that is a scene root or [CanvasLayer](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_canvaslayer.html) child, that resets its anchor preset every frame:

```GDScript
@tool
extends Control

func _process(_delta:float) -> void:
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
```

※ you could choose any [LayoutPreset](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_control.html#enum-control-layoutpreset) in place of ``PRESET_FULL_RECT``, but my [responsive UI plugin (version 1.1.0)](https://codeberg.org/sosasees/godot-4-responsive-ui-plugin/src/tag/1.1.0) chooses ``PRESET_FULL_RECT`` for its FullRectControl node type

title: update ``Control`` nodes' size when changing the _window size_ project settings
